conversations.title: I turned to online dating to find love of my life - but it's vile and exhausting
conversations.reply: That sounds like a really tough experience, and I'm so sorry you're going through it. You deserve so much better than to be treated like that.

conversations.title: Interabled Love: The Couples Defying The Odds
conversations.reply: It's great to see couples sharing their stories and showing that love can come in all forms. We need more of this kind of representation to break down barriers.

conversations.title: I was in a relationship where my able-bodied ex took advantage of the power dynamic
conversations.reply: That's a really tough thing to go through, and I'm so sorry you had to experience it. You deserve to be treated with respect and care, and it's great that you're speaking out.

conversations.title: Why the 'no wristband, no service' policy at Manchester Village Pride is a defiant choice
conversations.reply: The 'no wristband, no service' policy at Manchester Village Pride is a great example of how to create a more inclusive event. It's all about making sure everyone can participate and have a good time.

conversations.title: Humiliated bride left stranded at altar without a wheelchair ramp to reach her husband
conversations.reply: That's absolutely appalling, and I'm so sorry that happened. Every venue should be prepared to accommodate people with disabilities, it's just basic respect.

conversations.title: Norwich City Hall upgrade to include disabled access ramp
conversations.reply: It's great to see Norwich City Hall making changes to be more accessible. That's exactly the kind of progress we need to see.

conversations.title: Beach Wheelchairs - Great Yarmouth
conversations.reply: Beach wheelchairs are a great idea, and it's fantastic that Great Yarmouth is making an effort to be more accessible. Everyone should be able to enjoy the beach.

conversations.title: Insight : Making historic buildings work for modern life
conversations.reply: I completely agree, it's great when historic buildings are made accessible so everyone can enjoy them. It's all about sharing the experience, not changing the building itself.
